title: Why receiving notifications for deleted habits
body:
Hello there!

I just recently faced an issue where I am literally getting notifications for my deleted habits. But this should not happen. I have already deleted that habit, so technically this application should not store the habit information and should not send notifications to my Device.

Please look into this asap and send an update. Overall quality of the application is good as of now. Looking forward to your response.
